misconfig_patterns: DOCLING_API_KEY not set by default -- conversion endpoints open to unauthenticated callers
Health and version endpoints always exempt from auth even when API key is configured
UI playground (DOCLING_SERVE_ENABLE_UI=1) exposes full document conversion surface in browser with no auth
FastAPI /docs Swagger UI endpoint accessible by default -- enumerates all routes and schema

active_probe.false_positive_check: GET /version must return JSON containing 'docling' version string; /docs must reference /v1/convert paths

deployment_tells: FastAPI app at port 5001 -- Swagger UI at /docs
Auth uses X-Api-Key header (not Authorization: Bearer) -- diagnostic tell when sniffing
POST /v1/convert/source accepts multipart document upload; returns Markdown/JSON
IBM project; often co-deployed with watsonx or LangChain RAG pipelines
pivot_paths: POST /v1/convert/source with arbitrary PDF -> full Markdown extraction without auth when DOCLING_API_KEY unset
GET /docs -> full API schema enumeration without auth regardless of key config
GET /version or /health -> version disclosure; version-correlate to known upstream Docling CVEs
